Repository Change Proposals
|-- Intake -> shared ChangeSessionService lifecycle
|   |-- Direct create(title, requestId, repository context, optional canvasId)
|   |   `-- Project + requestId -> stable proposal ID
|   |       |-- Same input signature -> replay original creation result
|   |       `-- Different signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |-- DiffSessionWorkflowService: capture -> analyze -> materialize -> validate
|   |   |-- Requires AI enabled and pinned context with captured hunks
|   |   |-- Analyze: frozen baseline search, captured hunks, pinned source reads
|   |   |   `-- Source reader uses Git revisions; never the working tree
|   |   |-- Materialize: create one isolated proposal from the same capture
|   |   |   `-- Agent tools bind edits to this run's proposal
|   |   |       `-- Cannot target another ChangeSession
|   |   |-- Complete: own proposal is ready, has changes, maps every captured hunk
|   |   `-- Persist context, prompts, conversation and metrics
|   |       `-- Completion / failure / cancellation -> dispose agent session
|   `-- PushIntegrationService -> DiffSession workflow above
|       |-- Connection + eventId -> stable generation ID
|       |   |-- Concurrent/repeated delivery -> share or reuse generation
|       |   `-- Same eventId with different payload -> PUSH_EVENT_ID_CONFLICT
|       |-- Skip non-branch refs, deletions, unchanged refs and equal content trees
|       `-- GitPushSource resolves exact before/after commit objects
|           |-- Fetch missing objects; require full clone; cap at 2000 commits
|           |-- Classify update / new branch / force push
|           `-- Start workflow with head=after and comparisonBase=before
|               `-- Pinned graph is authoritative even if branch HEAD moves
|-- Capture -> isolated draft, version 0
|   |-- Freeze repositoryId + commits + head + optional comparisonBase
|   |   `-- captureGitHunks
|   |       |-- Commit selection -> each commit against its first parent
|   |       |-- Explicit comparison -> base to head; null base means empty tree
|   |       `-- Retain immutable patches; reject over 8 MiB or 2000 hunks
|   |-- Capture repository-owned settled canvases from the catalog
|   |   `-- Selected live workspace snapshots overlay saved representations
|   |       |-- Multiple live workspaces -> require canvasId
|   |       `-- Retain saved revision ID and captured live version
|   |-- Per document: baseline + cloned proposed state + forked canvas history
|   |   `-- Shared canvas history/controller machinery; proposal edits stay isolated
|   `-- Optional baselineChangeSessionId
|       `-- Reuse original baselines and pinned hunks from that session
|           `-- Reset proposed states and fork histories; reject mixed capture inputs
|-- Edit and explain the proposal
|   |-- MappingDocumentController.applyUpdate(documentVersion, operations)
|   |   |-- Record proposed document, canvas state, node origins and history
|   |   |-- Undo / redo / reset use the same controller history
|   |   `-- New canvas has baseline=null; reset requires a baseline
|   |-- Refresh generated changes for affected documents
|   |   |-- New canvas, diagram/display changes, incident edges, subtree variants
|   |   `-- Retain annotations: title, reasons and dependsOn
|   |-- DiffTree = tree revision + stable node mappings + captured hunks
|   |   |-- Default tree groups hunks by commit
|   |   |-- Mappings link tree nodes to hunks and optional diagram destinations
|   |   |-- Replace tree/mappings together; require expected revision when updating
|   |   `-- Read selected nodes -> deduplicated hunk IDs + unmapped node IDs
|   |-- Migrations explain code organization or feature ownership transfers
|   |   `-- Exact document / diagram / content-node / revision endpoints
|   |       |-- Source: baseline or proposed; destination: proposed
|   |       `-- Node or subtree scope; stale identities fail validation
|   `-- Mutation controls
|       |-- Serialize per session; replay matching request receipts
|       |-- Conflicting request signature or stale expected version -> reject
|       |-- Successful mutations increment session version and persist scoped changes
|       `-- Content/history/tree/migration edits return to draft
|-- Review -> ready gate
|   |-- ChangeSessionPreview loads one document's baseline and proposed states
|   |   |-- Worker refreshes with last-seen version; unchanged preview returns null
|   |   |-- Show edits, moves, migration marks, hunk coverage and treemap colors
|   |   |-- Local folding, panning, search and diff/regular display controls
|   |   `-- Linked-canvas navigation stays within the proposal
|   |-- Treemap reads use captured data from one coherent session generation
|   |   `-- Version changes during reads -> conflict; retry
|   `-- validateReady
|       |-- At least one change; canvases belong to the proposal repository
|       |-- Valid DiffTree and exact migration endpoints
|       |-- Dependencies exist and form no cycles
|       |-- All proposed connection anchors resolve
|       `-- Added diagram has an incoming edge from a diagram present in baseline
|-- Accept all changes(requestId, expectedVersion)
|   |-- Already accepted with same request/version -> replay summary
|   |   `-- Different request/version -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |-- Require current version, ready status and successful ready validation
|   |-- Check affected baseline documents against every matching live workspace
|   |   `-- Document content or name changed since capture -> VERSION_CONFLICT
|   |-- projectCatalogs.acceptCanvasChanges -> atomic catalog publication
|   |   `-- Pass affected proposed documents + histories + expected saved revisions
|   `-- Catalog acceptance receipt -> mark session accepted, increment version
|       |-- Receipt records change IDs and before/after checkpoints
|       |-- Interrupted session write -> catalog receipt remains authoritative
|       |   |-- List/preview project accepted status from matching receipt
|       |   `-- Open/accept repairs the full session record
|       `-- Accepted proposal is immutable; original review diff remains available
|           `-- UI opens the accepted canvas
`-- Persistence and retained lifecycle state
    |-- DiagramChangeSessionStore -> ChangeSessionRecords
    |   |-- Manifest: summary + references to documents, receipts and DiffTree
    |   |-- Immutable records: baseline/proposed states, history checkpoints, receipts
    |   |-- Scoped writes reuse unaffected records
    |   `-- Serialize publication; compare manifest token before publishing next manifest
    |       `-- Concurrent stale writer -> VERSION_CONFLICT
    |-- Scoped reads avoid full proposal hydration
    |   |-- List -> metadata; preview -> one baseline/proposed pair
    |   `-- Full read -> restore histories, revisions and replay receipts
    |-- Optional worker handles hydration, migration and writes
    `-- Status: draft -> ready -> accepted; edits may return ready to draft
        `-- Archive unaccepted proposals -> hidden from list; further edits rejected
